text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma told me.
She said, "The racing world is special."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
They say there's an extraordinary magic
that can only be used in that place—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "The 'magic of racing,' huh? It'd be so cool if that were real!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There is too!
If you think it's a lie,
it just means you don't know enough about magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, don't forget we're
having a mock race with everyone tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆
Maya's going full throttle～☆"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But Trainer, when you see Sui-chan run again,
you might just be amazed♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, I'm gonna show my familiar that I'm a master totally worth devoting herself to!

Starting today, training with
Sweep Tosho begins!

"Eager to discover the 'magic of racing,'
she volunteered to run a mock race herself.
Her motivation seemed to be overflowing—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Noooo waaayyyy!!

Surrounded by her classmates
Mayano Top Gun, Biko Pegasus, and Nishino Flower,
Sweep Tosho was throwing a tantrum.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nooo way! I'm not running with everyone anymore!
I'm! Not! Run! Ning--!!
choice_data_list: Wait, weren't we supposed to do a mock race...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
! Maya gets it now!
A maiden's heart is complicated☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, try remembering what you just said
a moment ago, okay?

"I recall the moment
Sweep Tosho first brought this group together."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo☆
Let's have a great time today♪

Appearing at the mock race were Mayano Top Gun,
renowned for her ever-shifting running styles,
along with two sprint specialists—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
You're accommodating us with the distance,
so the match will be 1,000m, but still...

One of the sprint specialists, Nishino Flower.
A prodigy whose talent blossomed early, allowing her to skip grades
and enroll in Tracen Academy.
choice_data_list: If anything, getting the chance to compete with you all is precious!
If anything, getting the chance to compete with all of you is precious!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! I'm getting fired up!
Time to warm uuuup!

She is Biko Pegasus.
An Umamusume who has inspired people by tenaciously holding
her ground no matter how formidable the opponent.
choice_data_list: If only I had guts like hers...!

text_block_list.text:
Racing against them will surely
be of great benefit to Sweep Tosho.
Just as I was feeling moved by that thought...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh, hey! Familiar,
*I'm* supposed to be your master, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, stupid stupid stupid stupid!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stupid familiar!
Hmph, whateverrrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Kya!? Swee-chan!?

Before anyone could stop her,
Sweep Tosho ran off the track.

Her back disappears in an instant,
like a shooting star.
That acceleration and speed are truly...

—Without a doubt, she was someone
blessed with a talent far greater than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are you zoning out for?!
Come on, hurry up and go after them!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We get that you two are great together, and don't worry about us, Maya and the others are totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Go pick up Sweep-chan for me!
Pretty please? ☆
And so, urged on by Mayano Top Gun and the others, I started searching from scratch for places where Sweep Tosho might be—
I was finally able to find her in the library!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!! Hmph!
Stupid, stupid familiar, you big dummy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
...Could it be that you're fighting?
With, you know, Sweep-san.

(She is Zenno Rob Roy.
An Umamusume in the Classic class this year, and good friends with Sweep Tosho.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I see. So right before the mock race with your friends, Sweep suddenly ran off, leading up to now...
choice_data_list: Her legs back then were so incredibly fast too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufu.
You can't hide the sparkle in your eyes, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...'Arrogance, turned inside out, is purity itself.
If so, then as a retainer, I too must serve my King with sheer purity.'"
choice_data_list: Is arrogance a form of purity?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, um... this is a passage from a book!
It's, well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Listening to what you've said, I think it would be best
for you to express your thoughts honestly.
...What do you think?
choice_data_list: Just my honest feelings right now...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
What's this, all of a sudden!?

I honestly explain to Sweep Tosho
what I felt today.

When looking at the roster for the mock race,
I felt deeply moved, knowing this opportunity
would undoubtedly serve Sweep Tosho well in the future.
Even when she ran off in anger once again, I couldn't help but be captivated by Sweep Tosho's raw talent.
choice_data_list: I thought your running was like magic.
I thought your running was like magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Are you an idiot?!
Did you really think calling it magical
would make me happy?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... if you really, um,
thought it was like magic..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come, familiar!
We're running one more time!!

And Sweep Tosho ran just a single lap for me.
The way she galloped so pleasantly at overwhelming speed was—
choice_data_list: It really is a magical way of running...!
It's that magical running style after all...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! 'Like' isn't good enough!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm the magical girl Sweepy, and I'm going to find the real 'magic of racing'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just to let you know, though, finding the 'Magic of Racing' is terribly hard and requires serious resolve, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma said that unless you run in lots of real races,
you won't be able to find it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So now that you're my familiar,
you gotta dedicate yourself entirely to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Until I find the "Magic of Racing," Master always comes first! There's no way I'd go crazy over some other girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So if, by some rare chance... Not that I think that would ever happen from here on out, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if someone's more amazing than me,
praise me first, not her!
Got that?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then it's a contract! It's a promise with Master, so you better never forget it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright, go call Mayano and the others back.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come now, a familiar must devote themselves
to their master! You've got an immediate chance
to be of use, so give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A mock race with that lineup is supposed to help me out down the road, right?

And so began our days with the selfish magical girl,
searching for the "Magic of Racing" while working her familiar to the bone!
